models.label: dots.ocr
models.description: The page reader: a 3B vision-language model that turns a rasterised page into its text and layout. Two files on a machine without Crucible — the text tower and its vision projector.

models.label: Qwen 3.5 · 0.8B
models.description: The smallest text model: fast, and able to read an image on a PC or Windows card. Every text verb reaches down to it, so a card too small for anything larger still decides, cleans, translates and generates, at the quality a 0.8B gives.

models.label: Qwen 3.5 · 2B
models.description: A small text model between the 4B and the 0.8B, reading images as well as text on a PC or Windows card. Every text verb runs on it where nothing larger fits.

models.label: Qwen 3.5 · 4B
models.description: A small text model, reading images as well as text on a PC or Windows card. Every text verb runs on it where nothing larger fits.

models.label: Qwen 3.5 · 9B
models.description: The cleanup model, in bf16. Cleanup and the other 9B-class text work; wants a 24 GB card at this precision.

models.label: Qwen 3.8 · 27B (4-bit)
models.description: The 27B, quantized to fit a 24 GB card: the goal for translation, simplification, analysis and generation.
